text:
jules: T-minus 45 to midnight slice. Quick checklist: change window pinned? freeze flags set? rollback plan in place?
sarah: Change window set 00:00-01:00 UTC, freeze starts -30m. Release notes + rollout plan posted in #eng-releases.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued by jules — scheduled at 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z. Canary config: waves [5,25,70].
own: Autoscale burst disabled for dedicated pools in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Extra warmup replicas spun up.
jules: @sre-oncall please lower alert thresholds for the slice and watch KV cache evictions. If p95 latency > 350ms for 5m or error rate > 0.5% -> trigger rollback.
sre-oncall: ack. thresholds adjusted. dashboard watchlist pinned.
liz: Changelog update includes model pin details and migration note. Link: https://redwood.internal/release/2026-03-20/v3.2.1 (internal)
sarah: Pins confirmed: runtime v2.4.2, model v3.2.1 pinned on prod. Command used: `deploybot pin --env prod --version v3.2.1`
jules: Deploy runbook reminder: rollback if canary fails -> `deploybot rollback --to v3.1.9` and flip API gateway pin.
deploy-bot: Canary wave 1 started — traffic=5%, wave_id=1.
sarah: Smoke checks: basic generation, embeddings, auth. All green. Small uptick in KV miss rate (~3%) but within expected.
own: Observed ~8% higher token-CPU for a single replica; still under SLO.
sre-oncall: No alerts firing. Watching memory and GPU temp.
jules: Proceed to wave 2 in +12m when deploy-bot reports stable.
deploy-bot: Canary wave 2 rolled to 25% traffic. wave_id=2. health=OK.
sarah: Running regression eval set (prompt-suite v12) — first 50 samples look good.
jules: Remember freeze: no infra changes during window. Only hotfixes with approvals.
liz: Added rollback checklist to release notes: incident channel, who-can-approve, and required logs snapshot command: ```curl -s https://logs/api/snapshot?since=10m | gzip > snapshot.tgz```
deploy-bot: Canary wave 3 -> 70% traffic, starting final validation.
sre-oncall: GPU mem steady, 0.03% 5xxs in the last 10m.
sarah: Final smoke and evals green. Go for full rollout at T+40 unless objections.
jules: No objections. Proceed when deploy-bot ready.
deploy-bot: Full rollout completed. version v3.2.1 active across prod.
sre-oncall: Post-rollout checks running for 30m. Dashboard baseline stable.
jules: Excellent. Keep the quiet window until +60. If any regression, follow rollback steps. Big thanks everyone. :tada: 
sarah: Posting post-launch summary and adding tags for retrospective.
system: maintenance window cleared, freeze lifted at 01:00 UTC as scheduled.
